provenance: 5th percentile of characters-per-second over the 12 gold transcripts of intronhealth/AfriSwitchCare config 'swahili' split 'test', minus a 10% safety margin. Durations are the dataset's own `duration` column. Derived by bench/derive_floor.py.
caveat: These are two-party consultations of 6-11 minutes; the product measures single-speaker turns of 20-110 seconds. Conversational pauses and turn-taking are included in the denominator here and are not in a product turn, so this floor is a conservative estimate rather than a like-for-like one. Recalibrate on field set C once it is recorded, which is single-speaker and matches the product's unit exactly.
